name: Visionox Technology Inc.
summary: Visionox Technology Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and technical service of organic light emitting diode display products in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent wearable and phone, laptop and tablet, and automotive display screens. It is also involved in electronic product manufacturing and sales; flat panel displays, modules, and systems and related products; project investment and consulting; import and export of goods or technology; technology development, transfer, and promotion; sale of computers, software, and auxiliary equipment, as well as chemical products; warehousing services; application services…
